item.text: {"piece_id":"02","ready":false,"issues":["Claim 02-c1’s locators do not support the stated Fusion import and material-assignment method; cite the exact passages describing those steps.","Claim 02-c2 is labeled reported_fact but its conclusion that the check does not establish reliable reconstruction is an inference.","Claim 02-c5 is labeled reported_fact although its figures come from an automatic podcast transcript not independently checked against audio or supplied primary evidence.","Claim 02-c5’s cited segments do not support that the tasks were simulated or that five models were tested; add matching locators or narrow the statement.","The argument calls this the “strongest current evidence,” a comparative claim not established by the supplied evidence."]}
